newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Uranium Res rated outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Uranium Res rated outperform.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said on Monday it initiated coverage of Uranium Resources Inc with a buy, rating the stock as outperform both for the six-month intermediate term and 18-month long term.
--Analyst Vahid Fahti in a report said his earnings per share estimates on the company are $0.06 for FY96, $0.18 for FY97, $0.21 for FY98 and $0.29 for FY99.
--Prices targets for the stock of the uranium mining company are $11 for the intermediate term and $19, long term.
